title: Iron Endurance
description: 10-minute EMOM followed by an 8-minute AMRAP to truly test your iron endurance

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide, toes pointing out

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Advance in continuous lunges with a big step

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than the shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Lower, rise halfway, lower again, then rise fully

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet lifted, rotate torso left and right

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate stepping forward left and right without pausing

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
